title: ORDER BY on a column sorts by its own values, not by the model's sort-by column

source.quote: Sort by column property in semantic models do not apply to DAX query results.

derivation: Date[Month] holds Jan, Feb, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar and is sorted by MonthNo in the model. The distinct values, sorted as text: Dec, Feb, Jan, Mar. By MonthNo they would be Jan, Feb, Mar, Dec.
